claims.citation: New York Herald, 3 July 1866, p. 3, col. 1
claims.verbatim:
The Cunard steamship Cuba, Captain Stone, which left
Liverpool at four o'clock June 23, and Queenstown the
24th, arrived at Halifax, N. S., at two o'clock yesterday
afternoon, en route for Boston. She has twenty-eight
Halifax and one hundred and seventeen Boston pas-
sengers. Purser Brown, of the Cuba, reports:—Spoke
no vessel. For the latter four or five days of the pas-
sage the weather was thick with fogs.
